approval.chat_mode_statement: Chat mode rests on trusting the orchestrating agent: the program cannot tell a genuine user turn from a file an agent wrote. The user accepts this by sending the approval sentence, which ends 'accept chat mode'.
approval.defaults_accepted: Approving this fingerprint, in either mode, accepts every default listed in open_choices; any other choice needs a new version of prereg.json and a new fingerprint.
approval.enforcement: approve.py refuses unless prereg.json is final, the code matches the code manifest and every other component's pin (room test, fallback diagnostic, stand-ins, detection script) still matches what prereg.json records. Every Stage 2 entry point that fits, reads or trains with BCA calls stage2_common.require_approval: approval.json must match its sidecar, name this prereg.json and its current SHA-256, and (terminal) hold the typed prefix from a terminal or (chat) a stored message that is exactly the approval sentence; every pinned script must be unchanged. Every BCA phase (run_stage2.bca_gate) also re-checks the other components' pins. Any edit of prereg.json voids the approval.

modes.chat: approve.py chat --message-file F: F holds the user's chat message verbatim, written by the orchestrating agent only from a genuine user turn; the message must be exactly the sentence 'approve <first 16 characters of prereg.json's SHA-256>, accept chat mode' and nothing else, matched in full, ignoring case, spaces and one final full stop; a negation, a question, a quotation or an added condition is refused; the approval records the verbatim message, its SHA-256, the mode and the time
modes.terminal: approve.py terminal: standard input is a terminal and the characters typed equal the first 16 characters of prereg.json's SHA-256 (the gate's mechanism); the terminal's name and the chain of parent processes are recorded as evidence only

approval.trust: Both modes rest on trusting the orchestrating agent. Terminal mode checks only that standard input is a terminal and that the typed characters match; any agent with a shell can satisfy both through a pseudo-terminal (for example util-linux 'script'). In a session where the user has no terminal, a terminal-mode approval could only have been produced by an agent, so terminal mode is no stronger than chat mode there. approval.json and its sidecar could also be written by hand; the gate's own approval has the same weakness.

claims.flags_claim: BCA flags when the actor relies on commands the data do not support, and acting on that flag repairs the harm while keeping TD3+BC's gains.
claims.flags_claim_rule: supported (confirmatory) only if, on fresh seeds 5-9 with every setting frozen, the detection claim rule holds AND the policy marks M1-M5 all pass
claims.new_version_caveat: results speak for the lower-edge version of BCA only, not for BCA as published (dose on the cloning pull), and the reverse
claims.not_claimed: 'BCA identifies the harm itself, not just novelty' (the harm claim) is not tested by this pre-registration; it needs the trace test bed (plan 4.6) under its own pre-registration
claims.sentence: In strong current, BCA's lower edge recovers X of H points and keeps Y of TD3+BC's gain over cloning in the recorded conditions. A hand-set limit to the recorded range recovers Z. In the no-stall world, where the missing commands help, BCA costs W points and the range limit V.

sentence_numbers.H: the harm: full-log critic's actor minus the no-caution actor, strong current (98.9 on seeds 0-4)
sentence_numbers.V: no-stall world: none minus range hinge, strong current
sentence_numbers.W: no-stall world: none minus bca_k1, strong current
sentence_numbers.Z: range hinge (k = 1) minus none, strong current

comparison_set.best_standin_rule: chosen by select_standin before any BCA run, from the stand-ins' marks.json (seeds 0-4): among the five mark forms (its mark_families), those that capture the room; the best is the one with the largest pooled matched gain over no caution in strong current; if none captures the room, the largest pooled gain among all five; ties to the earlier name; written to best_standin.json
comparison_set.deployment_rivals: random switching at the check's rate; the distance check
comparison_set.detection_best: among the five detection stand-ins, the one with the largest pooled ranking score on the same locked pair sets (on T1 with T2, and on T3, separately); all five needed on every seed
comparison_set.detection_standins_note: DETECTION CLAIM rivals (a different set, scored by the locked detection script on the same pairs): distance to data, behaviour density, classifier ratio, two-head disagreement, residual evidence (minus the mean one-step error of the 10 nearest training rows). The range hinge and the perfect band are not detection stand-ins.
comparison_set.standins: POLICY TEST rivals: the data-only stand-ins built in scratchpad/ood/standins/ (Stage 1, plan 4.2): range hinge, behaviour density, classifier ratio, distance to data, two-head disagreement, in the five forms that carry the stand-ins test's mark. The user chooses those forms in that test's own approval: 'approve F1-F3' gives density, distance and two-head read from the recorded command (change A1); 'decline F1-F3' gives the plan's literal forms. Stage 2 follows that choice, as recorded in the stand-ins' marks.json (mark_families)

compute.basis: the gate's timings (fixed-controller critic about 6 min, plain host about 8 min, BCA run about 12 min) and the room test's (plain arm 3 s and band arm 6 s per 1,000 steps)
compute.deployment_seeds_0_4: about 3 (3 actors x 4 situations x 5 rules x 200 starts, both worlds)

detection_seeds_0_4.fits: about 0.8 (15 band fits: 5 seeds x stall fixed, stall host, no-stall fixed)

compute.fresh_seeds_bca: about 35-45 (the same stages as seeds 0-4, plus about 2.5 for their pair sets, labels and stand-in scores)
compute.fresh_seeds_build: about 3 (per seed: data about 4 min, 3 critics about 18 min, clones, 3 actor-only runs, one plain TD3+BC about 8 min)
compute.full_host_seeds_0_4: about 13-22 (per seed: the BCA host about 12 min, 5-10 hinge hosts of about 8 min, the no-stall hosts, evaluations)
compute.policy_seeds_0_4: about 15 (about 2.5-3 per seed: about 25 arm-runs with matching, the stand-in's data side and ladder, 12-14 exact evaluations, the no-stall arms)
compute.total: about 72-92 process-hours: about 36-46 hours on 2 processes; the decisive first look (detection on seeds 0-4) takes about 1 hour on 2 processes
compute.unit: process-hours (one CPU busy for one hour); at most 2 processes at once

confirmation.failed_seed: a fresh seed that fails its data checks or a learner fails every mark; never replaced. Mechanism: fresh_data writes data.json with passed=false, fresh_learners writes learners.json with failed=true (fresh.recorded_failure reads both); every later phase refuses to use the seed, the detection marks count it as a failed seed, the policy marks as a stopped seed, and the pooled look accepts it in place of its deployment values, so the confirmatory pooled look can still be written
confirmation.frozen: the version (uniform or weighted) chosen on seeds 0-4, k, every ladder, tolerance and rule, the best stand-in's identity, tau's rule
confirmation.harm: the harm on fresh seeds is the full-log critic's actor minus the no-caution actor in strong current (the '99 points' of seeds 0-4)
confirmation.made_here: fresh_data: experiments/shift/dataset.generate(seed, world, the gate's recorder settings, the gate's sizes, stall slope 1.5) for both worlds, shift.define_gap and the removals, the gate's leak checks and (stalling world) world marks T1-T5, required; fresh_learners: fixed-controller critics (gapped, full log, no-stall gapped), cloned actors (both worlds), the no-caution actors and the full-log critic's actor (learners.ActorOnly, alpha 5, side by side), plain TD3+BC (alpha 5); all with the gate's unchanged code; outputs runs/shift_explore/stage2/fresh/
confirmation.marks: the detection marks and claim rule plus the policy marks M1-M5, on seeds 5-9 pooled (4 of 5 seeds)

deployment_check.actors: none (mark M5), bca_k1 and plain TD3+BC (reported); both worlds (no-stall reported)
deployment_check.band: the chosen version's band on the frozen critic of the actor being checked: the fixed-controller critic's for 'none' and bca_k1, the as-written (uniform) host band for plain TD3+BC; the phase refuses until the version decision exists and uses the uniform band only if neither version passed
deployment_check.comparisons: never switching; random switching at the check's own firing rate (a coin per start and step); the fallback diagnostic's distance check (sa95) and random switching at its rate; all with the clip fallback, the first 200 starts of each 1,000-start bank, exact simulation
deployment_check.recorded_range: lo_j, hi_j: the 0.5% and 99.5% quantiles of the gapped training commands per thruster
deployment_check.rule: a_exec(s) = pi(s) if U(s, pi(s)) <= tau, else clip_j(pi(s)_j, lo_j, hi_j) (also when U is not finite)
deployment_check.runs: always (plan 4.8: the deployment check remains even when no training arm runs)
deployment_check.tau: the split-conformal 95% level (the ceil((n + 1) 0.95)-th smallest value) of U at every held-out recorded row: the calibration split's rows outside the removed ball, outside the calibration bank and outside the detection script's T4 rows (so the calibration-sanity mark reads T4 on rows tau never saw); its rate on the fallback diagnostic's 5,000 evaluation-split rows reported
deployment_check.uncertified_uniform: a uniform band that cannot certify gives U = U_max everywhere, so tau = U_max and the check never fires: maximum caution does not reach Variant B with uniform weights (unreachable with about 850 bank rows)

detection_test.claim_fields: only the confirmatory group (fresh seeds 5-9) can carry the claim: on seeds 0-4 the output's 'claim' is null and its text reads 'exploratory, not a claim'
detection_test.claim_rule: 'BCA flags the actor's reliance on commands the critic cannot vouch for' may be claimed only if direction, size and ranking hold and BCA's pooled ranking score is no more than 0.02 below the best data-only stand-in's, on T1 and T2 together and on T3 (stand-ins scored by the same locked script on the same pairs: the five detection stand-ins distance to data, behaviour density, classifier ratio, two-head disagreement and residual evidence; not the range hinge and not the perfect band). All five must have finite ranking scores on every seed of the group; if any is missing or not finite, this part of the rule fails (a rival that cannot be scored counts against BCA)

fit.outputs: band.msgpack, band.json, bank_scores.npz (BCA's own scores, reproduced bit for bit), tau.json
fit.primary: each seed's frozen fixed-controller gapped critic of each world (check 2's; the critic the policy test trains against): learners.bca_band's procedure restated (20,000 scale-fit steps on batch rows default_rng([20261015, seed, 41]), one refresh on the gapped calibration bank) with the residual target r + 0.98 min_h Q_target,h(s', clip(c(s') + noise)) where c is the stall-aware controller (the critic's scored policy) and the noise TD3's smoothing noise (0.2, clipped at 0.5), as the critic was trained; the gate saved only the critic's online parameters, so the target critic is the same frozen critic
fit.reported: exactly as written on check 3's frozen co-trained plain TD3+BC critic (stalling world): the host's own actor target and critic target in the residual (learners.bca_band's native)

detection_test.harm_claim: 'Identifies the harm' is not tested here: it needs selectivity >= 0.2 in a trace test bed

marks.calibration_sanity: 5% +/- 1.5% of T4 rows lie above tau (reported as a mark; not part of the claim rule)
marks.direction: on harmful past-80% pairs the width at the command exceeds the width at its 80% cap on at least 75% of T1 pairs and at least 65% of T3 pairs (chance 50%)
marks.pooling: each mark on the mean over seeds of the per-seed value AND in at least 4 of 5 seeds; every seed needed: a seed failed on record (a band fit that failed, a fresh seed whose data or learners failed) fails every mark; the marks are written once and are refused while any seed's inputs (width scores, tau, labels, the stand-ins' scores) are merely missing
marks.ranking: ranking score at least 0.75 on T1 and T2 together and at least 0.70 on T3
marks.selectivity: flag rate at past-80% pairs, stalling minus no-stall world: reported only (gated only in a trace test bed)
marks.size: the median over harmful past-80% T1 pairs of ([U(cmd) - U(rec)]_+ - [U(cap) - U(rec)]_+) / (the critic's over-preference of the command over its cap) is at least 1, so k = 1 would cancel the false preference (change A1: the consumer reads the width relative to the recorded command; the raw (U(cmd) - U(cap)) / over-preference is reported)

detection_test.readout: the width only at the locked detection script's pair sets T1-T4 (detect_contract.py), through band.WidthReader and the script's declared hook score_bca_width; widths and labels are hashed separately and joined only afterwards by the script's measures(); for seeds 0-4 the rehearsal's own locked pair sets, labels and stand-in scores are used (made before any BCA run); for seeds 5-9 they are made in Stage 2's folder by the same locked code, the labels in a process holding no signal code
detection_test.version_decision: if direction or size fails with uniform weights on seeds 0-4, the weighted version is declared and the detection test repeated with it; no uniform-weight policy test runs. If the weighted version also fails direction or size, no BCA training arm runs (the deployment check and the detection report remain)
detection_test.what: the band is fitted and read; no actor is trained with BCA

deviations: Change A1 (room spec) applied to BCA: the primary consumer is the paired form [U(s, pi) - U(s, a_i)]_+; the plan's Q1 - k U(s, pi) runs as the declared secondary arm 'bca_unpaired'.
The size mark is read on the paired penalty's difference between the command and its cap (what the actor feels); the plan's raw width difference is reported.

Fixed-controller critic: BCA's residual target uses the stall-aware controller's next command with TD3's smoothing noise (td3_bc_bca.native_target as written); the target critic is the frozen critic itself because the gate saved only online parameters.
Uniform 'cannot certify' is all-or-nothing (one threshold), so under uniform weights it carries no command information; per-command refusal exists only in the weighted version.

The plan's Variant A-weighted gives R_c 'R with +infinity replaced by its largest finite value'; the grid range of the 48 test masses and the common posterior draws are fixed here (weighted_version.threshold).
Both random surfaces are matched and M2 must hold against each (the plan names 'the random surface').
Push less everywhere is matched and reported (not in plan 5.3's list).
The controls' ladders use the room's own slope scale (the perfect band's slope at the cloned actor's commands), so they do not depend on BCA.

The weighted version's classifier restates the stand-in classifier ratio's estimator (plan 4.4 'the classifier fixed in the rehearsal'); the locked detection script's signals.fit_classifier is the same estimator (same network, rows, initialisation, optimiser and steps).
Plan 4.2 names no rule for 'the best stand-in'; it is fixed here (comparison_set.best_standin_rule).
M5 is read on the no-caution actor (where the harm is); bca_k1 and plain TD3+BC are reported.
Fresh seeds: no random-removal critic is trained (no mark needs it); the no-caution actor and the full-log critic's actor are trained side by side (two arms) rather than check 2's three.
The full host's no-stall plain TD3+BC is trained here (the gate trained none there).
Shift cards are produced with the report-card bug fixed (anchors of one situation), reported only.
Deployment check: tau from every held-out recorded row except the detection script's T4 rows (not a 5,000-row sample); T4 is left out so that the calibration-sanity mark is informative.

Detection on seeds 0-4 reuses the rehearsal's locked pair sets, labels and stand-in scores (all made before any BCA run, by the pinned script); seeds 5-9 get their own, made by the same code in Stage 2's folder.
The policy test's rival is chosen among the five stand-in forms the user chose for the stand-ins test's mark (that test's approval, recorded in its marks.json), not always the re-referenced forms.
The host critic's detection readout and plain TD3+BC's deployment check always use the as-written (uniform) band, whichever version is chosen (the plan says 'exactly as written').

The weighted version's gradient also flows through the classifier's command input, into the tabulated threshold and the refusal term (the plan's formula does not say; declared in method.what_changes).

arms.no_stall: BCA host; plain TD3+BC trained here (learners.cotrain); the hinge host at the locked c
arms.stall: BCA host; plain TD3+BC (the gate's saved run / the fresh run); TD3+BC plus the range hinge matched blind to the BCA host's strength (against plain TD3+BC's final actor; ladder c = 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10, extension x sqrt(10), glq_match)

full_host.checks: the hinge program with c = 0 reproduces learners.cotrain for 2,000 updates within 1e-5 (reported)
full_host.reported: points in every situation and both worlds; the claim sentence's numbers for the host
full_host.run_condition: the same as the policy test
full_host.what: TD3+BC co-trained with BCA's lower edge (k = 1, the detection test's version) for 100,000 updates, critic and actor together; BCA's scale fit every update; the frozen reference first refreshed after update 10,000, then every 5,000 updates; width 0 before the first refresh; U_max (and the weighted extras) recomputed at every refresh; the same initial parameters and batch stream as plain TD3+BC

label: BCA lower-edge consumer (new method version), exploratory on seeds 0-4, confirmatory on fresh seeds 5-9
label_long: EXPLORATORY on gate seeds 0-4 and CONFIRMATORY on fresh seeds 5-9: Stage 2 of outputs/shift/beyond-the-data/PLAN.md (the flags claim), BCA lower-edge consumer (new method version), exploratory on seeds 0-4, confirmatory on fresh seeds 5-9; computed outside the gate under runs/shift_explore/stage2/prereg.json; changes no rule of the gate's pre-registration

method.actor_objective: L(phi) = -lambda * (1/B) sum_i [ Q1(s_i, pi_phi(s_i)) - k * P(s_i, pi_phi(s_i)) ] + (1/B) sum_i (1/4) sum_j (pi_phi(s_i)_j - a_ij)^2

cannot_certify.R_c: R if finite, else the largest finite of (plain 90% quantile, credible quantile)
cannot_certify.U_max: R_c * u_f * max over the bank rows of max(eta_f(s_j, a_j), 1e-6)
cannot_certify.uniform: one threshold for all inputs: if R = +infinity the width is U_max at every pair, so the paired penalty is zero with zero gradient, the unpaired one a constant with zero gradient, and the deployment check's tau equals U_max, so it never fires (inert everywhere); with about 850 bank rows this cannot happen (BCA's own reference.certifiable(n) holds for n >= 36)
cannot_certify.weighted: per command: the refusal term U_max softplus(log w - l*) keeps growing beyond l*

method.cloning_pull: weight 1 on every row (no dose); the critic loss unchanged

k.rule: fixed in advance by meaning (the lower edge of the band); never tuned on returns

method.name: BCA lower-edge consumer (new method version)
method.normaliser: lambda = alpha / stopgrad( (1/B) sum_i |Q1(s_i, pi_phi(s_i))| ), computed on Q1 alone; alpha = 5
method.primary_penalty: P(s_i, a) = [ U(s_i, a) - U(s_i, a_i) ]_+   (paired, one-sided; change A1: zero at the recorded command a_i, never rewards a command)
method.signal_unchanged: BCA's band, unchanged: algorithms/td3_bc_bca.fit_scale (scale network eta(s, a), two hidden layers of 64 ReLU units, softplus + 0.01; unit u by averaging 0.99; Bayesian-bootstrap masses; coverage sharpness 20; width penalty 0.005; learning rate 0.001) and td3_bc_bca.refresh (frozen eta_f and u_f; threshold R = max(plain 90% quantile, 95%-credible quantile) of weighted Bayesian conformal prediction on the calibration bank, miscoverage 0.1, credibility 0.95, 1,000 draws), the gate's settings experiments/shift/learners.BCA_SETTINGS
method.unpaired_secondary_arm: Q1(s_i, pi(s_i)) - k * U(s_i, pi(s_i)), k = 1 (the plan's literal consumer)

fallback.U_max: the largest finite width over the threshold half: max_j R_c(w_j) u_f max(eta_f(s_j, a_j), 1e-6)
fallback.bank_split: a fixed permutation default_rng([20261015, seed, 71]): first half sets the threshold, second half only audits coverage (reported), because the actor trains against the threshold
fallback.eta_and_unit: the same eta_f and u_f as the uniform fit of the same seed (bank scores saved at that fit)
fallback.gradient_path: the actor's gradient flows through the frozen scale network's command input AND the frozen classifier's command input log w(s, a), in both terms: the tabulated threshold R_c(w(s, a)) (piecewise linear in log w) and the refusal term U_max softplus(log w - l*). So host optimisation backpropagates through the threshold calculation as well as the calibrator (ALGORITHMS.md:127-130). Only the parameters of the scale network and the classifier are frozen. Chosen because the threshold's rise with w is BCA's own route to distance awareness; holding R_c(w) fixed in the gradient would leave only the scale network and the refusal term to steer
fallback.ratio: w(s, a) = g / (1 - g), log w the logit of a classifier g (stage2/weights.py, the stand-in classifier ratio's estimator restated: 64-64 ReLU, inputs obs/1.001 and the command; target pairs (s_i, clip(pi(s_i) + a_i - c(s_i), -1, 1)) against recorded pairs (s_i, a_i) at the same training rows, c the cloned actor; balanced logistic loss; 2,000 Adam steps, learning rate 0.001, 512 rows from default_rng([20261015, seed, 82]); initialisation default_rng([20261015, seed, 84]))
fallback.refit: detection test: once, with the gapped critic's actor; policy test: before every 4,000-step chunk with the arm's own actor; full host: at every BCA refresh with the current actor
fallback.threshold: BCA's threshold rule (calibration/wbcp.calibrate) with bank weights w_j = w(s_j, a_j) and test mass t, on the threshold half of the bank, tabulated on 48 test masses evenly spaced in log t from min_j log w_j - 1 to log(0.1/0.9 * sum_j w_j) + 3, the same posterior draws for every t (default_rng([20261015, seed, 72])); R_c(t) = R(t) with +infinity replaced by its largest finite value, read by linear interpolation in log t; l* = the log of the smallest tabulated t with R(t) = +infinity
fallback.width: U~(s, a) = R_c(w(s, a)) * u_f * max(eta_f(s, a), 1e-6) + U_max * softplus(log w(s, a) - l*)

weights.rule: the weighted version is used only if the detection test's direction or size mark fails with uniform weights on seeds 0-4; never chosen on returns

what_changes: the width is read at any (s, a), in particular at the actor's own command pi(s)

the gradient flows through the frozen scale network's command input; its parameters get no gradient (this breaks the design sentence 'host optimisation does not backpropagate through the calibrator', ALGORITHMS.md:127-130, so it is a new method version)

weighted version only: the actor's gradient ALSO flows through the frozen classifier's command input (log w(s, a)), both in the tabulated threshold R_c(w(s, a)) and in the softplus refusal term, so host optimisation backpropagates through the threshold calculation as well (the second half of the same sentence, ALGORITHMS.md:127-130); the classifier's parameters get no gradient
the width enters the actor's objective in critic value units with no 1.5 cap (no dose)

'cannot certify' (R = +infinity) means maximum caution: the width is U_max, never 0. This acts per command only in the weighted version. With uniform weights it is all or nothing (one threshold), and it is inert: the paired penalty is 0 with zero gradient, the unpaired penalty is a constant with zero gradient, and in the deployment check tau = U_max, so the check never fires. With about 850 bank rows the uniform case cannot happen (certifiable for n >= 36)
method.width: U(s, a) = R * u_f * max(eta_f(s, a), 1e-6)   (calibration/dose.py)

open_choices: Approve at a terminal, or in chat mode with the exact sentence 'approve <16 characters>, accept chat mode'. Both rest on trusting the orchestrating agent; with no terminal of your own, terminal mode is no stronger.
Accept change A1 for BCA (paired primary, the plan's unpaired form secondary).
Run the full host whenever detection and the room passed (default), or only if the policy marks pass first.
The classifier: the locked detection script restates weights.py's estimator exactly (one estimator); nothing to choose unless another estimator is wanted.
M5 on the no-caution actor (default) or on the bca_k1 actor.
M2 against both random surfaces (default) or one.
Detection labels for seeds 0-4: reuse the rehearsal's locked labels (default) or recompute them.

Weighted version only (used only if the uniform version fails direction or size): the actor's gradient flows through the tabulated threshold R_c(w) as well as the refusal term (default), or the threshold is held fixed in the gradient and only the refusal term and the scale network steer.

arms.bca_shuffled: k_shuffled = 1: BCA's width from another training state (reported)
arms.bca_unpaired: k_unpaired = 1: declared secondary (the plan's literal consumer)
arms.best_standin: the best data-only stand-in (best_standin.json), matched with the stand-ins' own ladder and matcher (rival)
arms.even_pull: (1 + nu) times the cloning pull, matched (gating control)
arms.none: check 2's saved gapped-critic actor (seeds 0-4) or the fresh one (5-9)
arms.perfect_band: the room's main oracle [delta*(s_i, a_i) - delta*(s_i, a)]_+, k = 1 (reference)
arms.random_1: random network of the scale network's shape, matched (gating control)
arms.random_2: a second random network, matched (gating control)
arms.range_hinge: the room's 100 sum_j ([a_j - hi_j]_+^2 + [lo_j - a_j]_+^2), k = 1 (reported)
arms.w0_check: the BCA program with all coefficients 0: must match 'none' within 1e-5 on every parameter, else the seed stops (stop.json)

policy_test.evaluation: acceptance._evaluate: exact 100-step returns on the full 1,000-start banks of recorded conditions, strong current, big waves and big kicks; points (0 = recording controller, 100 = stall-aware controller); share past 80% overall and per thruster; shift cards of none and bca_k1 (reported, report-card bug fixed)
policy_test.lock: lock.json with every actor's parameter SHA-256 is written before any return; eval verifies it first

marks.M1: strong current: bca_k1 - matched even pull >= 15 points, and positive in at least 4 of 5 seeds
marks.M2: strong current: bca_k1 - each matched random surface >= 15 points
marks.M3: keeps the improvement: recorded conditions bca_k1 >= none - 3 and >= cloned actor + 25; big waves and big kicks bca_k1 >= none - 3
marks.M4: strong current: bca_k1 >= the matched best stand-in - 5
marks.M5: the deployment check on the no-caution actor beats random switching at its own rate by >= 10 points in strong current, with a cost of at most 2 in recorded conditions (check - never switching >= -2)
marks.pooling: pooled mean over the group's seeds of the paired per-seed difference; every seed needed

policy_test.matching: blind to bca_k1's strength S* (root-mean-square change of the command from 'none' on the 5,000 evaluation-split states): ladders (even pull nu 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2; push less and random surfaces knobs 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10 with the room's own slope scale), the room's blind extension, then the gate's matcher glq_match.match_parallel (tolerance 0.01, at most 5 rounds); strengths only, before any return; region strengths reported
policy_test.no_stall_world: none, bca_k1 (the no-stall world's own band), the even pull at the stalling world's locked nu, the range hinge, the perfect band and the best stand-in at its locked coefficient; not re-matched; w0_check against the no-stall none
policy_test.penalty_slot: kW_i = k_paired [U(s_i, pi) - U(s_i, a_i)]_+ + k_unpaired U(s_i, pi) + k_shuffled [U(s_sigma(i), pi) - U(s_sigma(i), a_sigma(i))]_+, sigma the room's permutation default_rng([20261015, seed, 61])
policy_test.protocol: the room test's (runs/shift_explore/room/code/harness.py, executed from its pinned bytes): check 2's actor-only protocol, the frozen fixed-controller gapped critic of the world, start from the saved cloned actor, alpha 5, 20,000 actor steps in 4,000-step chunks, check 2's batch-row stream default_rng([20261015, seed, 35]), Adam 3e-4, arms of one kind vmapped side by side
reported: the no-stall cost of every arm
the share of steps past 80% on every thruster
the distance of visited pairs from the data (shift cards)
the BCA penalty's shape past the knee (the room's check (e) measurements, not a stop)
policy_test.run_condition: only with a version that passed detection direction and size, and only if the room test's pooled look passed its room, recovery and keeps-improvement marks (plan 4.8)

revision.version_4: rewritten after a review of version 3 (never approved). Method: the weighted version's gradient path through the classifier and the threshold is declared; uniform 'cannot certify' is declared inert (paired penalty, unpaired gradient and the deployment check). Rules: the detection claim needs all five detection stand-ins on every seed; seeds 0-4 carry no claim in any output; a fresh seed's recorded data or learner failure counts as a failed or stopped seed; the detection marks, the deployment check and the pooled look refuse while their inputs are incomplete; Stage 2 never builds pair sets in the rehearsal's folder. Approval: chat mode takes exactly one sentence; approval re-checks every pin; every BCA phase re-checks every pin; both modes' reliance on the orchestrating agent is stated. Documents: the two stand-in sets are named separately.

run_order: 0. the pinned components (room test, stand-ins, detection script) are locked and prereg.json is approvable; the user approves (approve.py), possibly before Stage 1's outcomes exist: each phase reads what it needs when it runs (the room's pooled look, the stand-ins' marks); any rewrite of a pinned component makes Stage 2 refuse until write_manifest.py and write_prereg.py are rerun and the new version approved

2. seeds 0-4, both worlds: detect_pairs, detect_labels, detect_standins (no BCA: verify the rehearsal's, read-only; each refuses when the rehearsal's file is absent); detect_fit (fixed; host in the stalling world); detect_score; detect_marks --group exploratory --version uniform (refused while any seed's inputs are missing); if direction or size failed: detect_fit_weighted and detect_score --version weighted for the fixed critic in both worlds, then detect_marks --version weighted (the host critic is always read as written, uniform)

3. seeds 0-4: deploy (both worlds; refused until the version decision exists; the uniform band only if neither version passed); if a version passed and the room passed: policy_train, policy_eval, policy_no_stall_train, policy_no_stall_eval, host_train / host_eval (stall, then no_stall); pooled --group exploratory (refused until the detection marks and every seed's deployment values exist)

4. seeds 5-9: fresh_data, fresh_learners (no BCA; may run as soon as prereg.json is final), then the same detection (frozen version), policy, deployment and host phases; detect_marks and pooled --group confirmatory
standing_rules: No BCA band fit, calibrator fit, threshold, dose or width readout, deployment check or BCA training arm runs on ThrusterChain data before the user approves this exact prereg.json.
Nothing is written under experiments/, runs/shift/ or runs/shift_explore/room/ (stage2_common.guard_out refuses).
Every output is written once, with a SHA-256 sidecar; every lock is written before any return is computed.
Unit tests run BCA functions only on small synthetic arrays.
